details.text: Isolated wind damage remains possible overnight

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Vigorous convection persists early this morning from northeast OH into parts of northwest and central PA. Much of this activity is ongoing north of a composite outflow, which will tend to limit severe-wind potential, though MUCAPE of greater than 1000 J/kg and moderate deep-layer shear may continue to support occasionally organized storm structures and isolated wind-damage potential. A small cluster that moved off of Lake Erie and produced a 51 kt gust near Ashtabula, OH will move through a somewhat more favorable environment in the short term, with wind-damage potential. However, unless this cluster begins to propagate more southeastward, any severe threat will tend to remain isolated. Trends will continue to be monitored for storm development or propagation into the somewhat warmer and more unstable environment across west-central/southwest PA through the overnight
